description: This Java class defines an Android activity named NextActivity, which is launched from LaunchActivity. It retrieves a string payload from the intent extras and displays it in a TextView. It includes a factory method to create intents for launching this activity with specified payload data.

classes.name: NextActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a payload string received through intent extras in a TextView.

methods.name: makeIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to launch NextActivity with a specified string payload.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and displays the payload string if available.
